name: ClipBot
postStartCommand: bash -c 'export CLIPBOT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN="https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-8765.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN}" CLIPBOT_HOME="$PWD/.clipbot-data"; mkdir -p "$CLIPBOT_HOME"; grep -qxF /.clipbot-data/ .git/info/exclude || echo /.clipbot-data/ >> .git/info/exclude; nohup python clipbot.py serve --bind 0.0.0.0 > "$CLIPBOT_HOME/server.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &'
